mods.name: Ranking List
mods.description: A lightweight Fabric leaderboard mod with server-synced stats and a configurable client HUD for Minecraft 1.21.11.

releases.notes:
## Overview

  Ranking List is a lightweight Fabric leaderboard mod for Minecraft 1.21.11.

  It tracks common player stats, stores leaderboard data per world, and shows a compact configurable HUD on the client.

  ## Included Stats

  - Online time
  - Move distance
  - Blocks mined
  - Blocks placed
  - Jumps
  - Deaths
  - Mob kills
  - Player kills

  ## Features

  - Works in singleplayer and Fabric servers
  - Client HUD with drag positioning
  - Anchor selection
  - Transparency adjustment
  - HUD scale down to 25%
  - Preset save/load/delete
  - Single metric or carousel display
  - Server command: `/ranking top <metric>`

  ## Requirements

  - Minecraft 1.21.11
  - Fabric Loader 0.18.4+
  - Fabric API 0.141.3+1.21.11
  - Java 21

  ## Installation

  ### Singleplayer
  Install the jar in your local `mods` folder.

  ### Dedicated server
  - Install on the server to record leaderboard data and enable `/ranking top <metric>`
  - Install on the client to use the HUD and config screens

  ## File

  Download and place this file into your `mods` folder:

  - `ranking-list-1.0.0+mc1.21.11.jar`
